name: Orthogonal Reslicing and Projection of Fly Brain
description:
You are a neurobiologist analyzing a confocal Z-stack of a Drosophila brain. Your goal is to generate a 'side view' (XZ cross-section) projection to visualize the depth of the signal.

1. Open the built-in 'Fly Brain' sample (File > Open Samples > Fly Brain).
2. Convert the image stack to 8-bit grayscale (Image > Type > 8-bit).
3. Reslice the stack to view it from the 'Top' (Image > Stacks > Reslice). Use the default 1.0 pixel spacing.
4. Create a Maximum Intensity Projection of this new resliced view (Image > Stacks > Z Project...).
5. Save the final single-plane projection image to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/side_view_projection.tif'.

The final image should have dimensions corresponding to the original width (256) by the original depth (57).
